subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Toyota Corolla
description: A quick win: understand The Toyota Corolla.

hook.text: The Toyota Corolla is the best-selling car nameplate of all time—over 50 million and counting.

buildup.text: Launched in 1966, it offered basic reliable transportation. Nothing flashy, nothing broken.

discovery.text: Toyota updated it every few years, always improving quality without raising the price dramatically.

twist.text: No one loves a Corolla passionately—but millions trust it completely. Boring became its superpower.

climax.text: It's sold in over 150 countries. For many people worldwide, Corolla is their first car.

punchline.text: The world's best-selling car was never the most exciting.

quiz.question: How many Toyota Corollas have been sold worldwide?
